title: What happened in AI — Sep 13, 2026
intro: Agent-runtime tooling matured today: GitHub Copilot's HydraFusion routes coding tasks across models at runtime, the open-source Council queries five independent advisors before an agent acts, and AgentJIT compiles LLM agent workflows into sub-millisecond Python — all chasing faster, more auditable execution over raw capability.

Chinese labs kept compounding: Kimi K2.5 targets long-context agentic use, Kimi K3 is credited with $1B revenue despite Anthropic's claim Claude was used covertly to build it, and Z.ai raised another $5B. DeepSeek's claimed 75%/87.5% KV-cache HBM/SSD cut also spooked Samsung and SK Hynix investors.
highlights: GitHub Copilot's HydraFusion routes coding tasks across multiple models at runtime instead of one fixed model.
Council is an open-source pattern that runs an agent's decision past five independent advisor models before it acts.
AgentJIT compiles dynamic LLM agent workflows into 0.1ms Python to strip out orchestration overhead.
Moonshot's Kimi K3 drove $1B in revenue, but Anthropic says Claude was used covertly to build it.
DeepSeek claims a 75%/87.5% cut to KV-cache HBM/SSD needs, spooking Samsung and SK Hynix investors.
Z.ai raised a fresh $5B just months after its last round, while Kimi K2.5 targets long-context agentic work.

categories.name: Agent Runtimes & Harness Engineering
